item.tib: bstan srung rgyal chen grags pa seng ge'i ka bstod dgyes pa'i gar tshom
item.coloph: ces bstan srung dgyes pa gar gyi tshom bu 'di ni/ thos chung rmongs blun mkhan ming bsnya d+hI lam bdag gis gang shar ngos nas gtang rag tshul du bstod de bris par ma legs sdeb nyes gyur tshad gnas bzhir bshegs shing / dge bas las kyi srung ma 'di nyid bstan 'dzin dam ldan rnams la lus grib bzhin du 'grogs shing sangs rgyas bstan pa skyong ba'i grogs su gyur cig/
